tool_input.content:
# Project Memory: my-fortune-site (꿈해몽)

## Key Behavioral Rules
- [feedback_no_autonomous_execution.md] — Never launch agents or pipelines unless explicitly asked. "Pick up where we left off" = brief on state, then wait.

## UI Design System
- [project_ui_design.md] — Homepage redesign, STYLE_GUIDE.md, midnight/gold palette across all pages, 명조체 rule

## Content Validation Pipeline
- [project_validation_pipeline.md] — content-validator-agent + sync-changed-to-firestore.mjs; batch size 10 for validation (vs 6 for generation)

## Project Overview
Korean dream interpretation website (꿈해몽) — bilingual KO + EN, SEO-first, ad revenue model.
- Target: Both Naver and Google
- Language: Korean + English with language switch toggle
- Runtime: Next.js on Vercel Hobby — **LIVE at kkumhaemong.com** ✅
- Content: LLM-generated from scratch

## Infrastructure (COMPLETE ✅)
- **Hosting**: Vercel Hobby — deployed, DNS connected to kkumhaemong.com
- **Rendering**: ISR (`revalidate = 86400`, `dynamicParams = true`) on dream/category/explore pages. Build time ~42s.
- **Images**: Firebase Storage — `gs://my-fortune-site.firebasestorage.app` (asia-northeast3). Public URL: `https://storage.googleapis.com/my-fortune-site.firebasestorage.app/images/dreams/{slug}/{name}.webp`
- **Content JSON**: Firestore collection `dreams`, doc ID = english slug (413 docs + `views` int field)
- **Taxonomy**: filesystem (`data/taxonomy/*.json`) — small/stable, stays in git
- **Image generation**: Imagen 4 (`imagen-4.0-generate-001`), same GCP project as Firebase
- **`public/images/dreams/`** + **`data/content/`**: in `.gitignore` — Firestore is source of truth
- **Env vars**: `FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID`, `FIREBASE_CLIENT_EMAIL`, `FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY`
  - ⚠️ FIREBASE_PRIVATE_KEY: paste raw key WITHOUT surrounding quotes in Vercel — quotes break auth
- **`next.config.ts`**: `remotePatterns` for storage.googleapis.com + `serverExternalPackages: ["firebase-admin"]`
- **GitHub**: `git@github-llnormll:llnOrmll/kkumhaemong.git` (SSH alias on port 443)
- **Search index**: `public/search-index.json` committed to git (413 entries). Build script bails if no content files — prevents empty overwrite on Vercel. Run `node scripts/build-search-index.mjs` locally after adding content, then commit.

## Agents Created
All in `.claude/agents/`:
- `dream-taxonomy-agent` — enumerates all dream symbols → `data/taxonomy/*.json`
- `dream-research-agent` — researches one symbol deeply → `data/research/{category}/{slug}.json`
- `dream-content-agent` — generates bilingual SEO page content → `data/content/{category}/{slug}.json`
- `dream-image-agent` — generates images via Imagen 4 → `public/images/dreams/{slug}/` + uploads to Firebase
- `meta-agent` — creates new subagents (use for new agent creation)
- Custom agents (.claude/agents/*.md) cannot be used as subagent_type — read .md and pass to general-purpose agent

## Data Pipeline
```
dream-taxonomy-agent
  → data/taxonomy/*.json
      ↓ per symbol (parallel: research + image)
dream-research-agent → data/research/{category}/{slug}.json
dream-image-agent    → Firebase Storage + public/images/dreams/{slug}/
      ↓
dream-content-agent  → data/content/{category}/{slug}.json + Firestore (dreams/{slug})
      ↓
Next.js ISR pages (reads from Firestore on first request, cached 24h)
```

## Data Schema
### Taxonomy entry
`id`, `korean`, `english`, `slug`, `category`, `subcategory`, `related`, `searchTier` (high/medium/longtail)

### Research entry (`data/research/{category}/{slug}.json`)
- `symbol`: { korean, english, slug }
- `summary`: { korean, english }
- `interpretations`: [{ type: 길몽|흉몽|neutral, korean, english, context }]
- `variations`: [{ keyword_ko, keyword_en, interpretation_ko, interpretation_en }]
- `culturalContext`: { korean, english }
- `westernContext`: { freudian, jungian, modern, crossCultural } — each { korean, english }
- `relatedSymbols`: string[] (slugs)
- `seoKeywords`: { korean[], english[] }
- `faqs`: [{ question_ko, answer_ko, question_en, answer_en }]

### Content entry (`data/content/{category}/{slug}.json` + Firestore `dreams/{slug}`)
- ko + en versions of: title, metaDescription, h1, intro, sections, variations, culturalContext, westernContext, faqs, conclusion
- images: { hero: Firebase Storage URL, sections: { auspicious, inauspicious } }
- seo: { slug, koreanSlug, ogTitle, ogDescription, ogImage, structuredData, hreflang, relatedSlugs, naverSEO }
- **`relatedSlugs` must be inside `seo` object** (not root level)

## Hooks (`.claude/settings.json`)
- PreToolUse: blocks .env access + dangerous rm -rf (via pre_tool_use.py)
- Stop: logs to logs/stop.json
- SubagentStop: logs to logs/subagent_stop.json
- Notification (permission_prompt only): logs to logs/notification.json

## App Structure (implemented, build ✅)
- `src/middleware.ts` → next-intl locale routing (deprecation: rename to proxy.ts in Next.js 16)
- `src/i18n/routing.ts` → locales + pathnames map (ko: /꿈해몽/[slug], en: /dream/[slug], + /탐색/[category])
- `src/lib/firestore.ts` → Firebase Admin SDK singleton (credentials from env vars)
- `src/lib/taxonomy.ts` → server-only, fs/promises, reads data/taxonomy/*.json
- `src/lib/content.ts` → server-only, Firestore reads via Admin SDK
- `src/components/layout/` → Header, Footer
- `src/components/dream/` → DreamHero, DreamSection, DreamVariations, DreamFAQ, RelatedDreams, DreamCard
- `src/components/common/AdSlot.tsx` → placeholder ad div (ready for AdSense)
- `src/components/home/SearchBar.tsx` → client component, loads /search-index.json on first keystroke
- `src/components/dream/ViewTracker.tsx` → client component, fires POST /api/view on mount
- `src/app/api/view/route.ts` → increments Firestore `views` field on dream doc
- `src/components/explore/CategoryDreamList.tsx` → client component with subcategory filter pills
- `next.config.ts` → remotePatterns for storage.googleapis.com + serverExternalPackages firebase-admin

## Content Progress — PHASE 2 IN PROGRESS (as of 2026-03-17)
- **Phase 1 baseline**: 413 articles across 24 categories (actions: 161, others: 9–10 each)
- **Phase 2 expansion**: animals (212 research ✅), body (181 research ✅) complete
- Content in Firestore `dreams` collection (source of truth). Local `data/content/` not in git.
- Batch size: 6 agents in parallel (confirmed optimal)
- Image generation: Imagen 4 via Google Generative Language API. `source ~/.zshrc` required for GOOGLE_API_KEY.

### Current Content Gaps
Research done but content NOT yet generated:
- **animals**: 212 research files, ~29 content → **~183 pending**
- **body**: 181 research files, ~10 content → **~171 pending**
- **actions**: ~4 pending
- disasters, numbers, places: 1 each

## Permissions
- `.claude/settings.json` allow list: `Bash(*)` + WebSearch + WebFetch
- Pre-tool-use hook blocks .env access and dangerous rm -rf

## Content Quality Values (locked)
1. **Immediate interpretation + hook** — meaning in first sentence, pull-forward cliffhanger
2. **Enjoyable, confident voice** — warm authority, like a knowledgeable friend

### Prose Quality Rules (enforced via scripts + agent prompt)
- **No `**bold**` openers** in section bodies
- **No spaced em-dash ` — ` in Korean prose** — script: `scripts/strip-em-dashes.mjs`
- **No `그런데 한 가지—`** — rewrote 392/413 via GPT-4o-mini. Content agent uses 6 varied alternatives.
- OpenAI API key: `OPENAI_API_KEY` in `.env`

## Open Decisions
- [x] Domain: **kkumhaemong.com** ✅
- [x] Infrastructure: Firebase + Vercel ✅
- [x] GitHub repo: `llnOrmll/kkumhaemong` ✅
- [x] Vercel deployment: Live ✅
- [x] ISR rendering: switched from SSG, build time 42s ✅
- [ ] Ad slot implementation (AdSense + Kakao AdFit)
- [ ] Naver Blog mirroring strategy
- [ ] Rename `src/middleware.ts` → `src/proxy.ts` (Next.js 16 deprecation)

## Competitive Landscape
- **kkumhaemong.co.kr** — primary competitor, WordPress, 217+ pages, Korean-only, no structure
- Our advantages: bilingual, JSON-LD SEO, category taxonomy, variations+FAQ+westernContext, mobile-first UX

## Key SEO Notes
- High-volume symbols: 돼지꿈, 뱀꿈, 이빨빠지는꿈, 똥꿈, 임신꿈
- Long-tail is competitive advantage (color/action/context variations)
- Each page: 800-1500 words per language, FAQ critical for featured snippets
